description: This file contains unit tests for the Halo streaming functionalities using Azure Queue streams in the Orleans framework. It defines a test class HaloStreamSubscribeTests which includes setup fixtures, configuration, and test methods to verify consumer-producer and producer-consumer resubscription scenarios in a distributed Orleans environment.

classes.name: HaloStreamSubscribeTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies streaming subscriptions and resubscription logic for Azure Queue streams in Orleans, including cluster setup and individual test cases.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: A fixture class extending BaseAzureTestClusterFixture to configure and manage an Orleans test cluster with Azure Queue stream providers and storage.

methods.name: Halo_AzureQueue_ResubscribeTest_ConsumerProducer
methods.description: Tests resubscription behavior when a consumer joins before the producer and then both reconnect.

methods.name: Halo_AzureQueue_ResubscribeTest_ProducerConsumer
methods.description: Tests resubscription behavior when a producer joins before the consumer and then both reconnect.

methods.name: ConsumerProducerTest
methods.description: Performs a test where consumer joins first, then producer, then checks that messages are correctly propagated.

methods.name: ProducerConsumerTest
methods.description: Performs a test where producer joins first, then consumer, then checks that messages are correctly propagated.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Checks that the number of produced messages matches the number consumed for a producer-consumer pair.
